b2-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: As Soon As
b2-07-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks when you will send her the report from your office in Budapest. You will send it right after you finish it.
b2-07-01.prompt: Tell Meg when you will send the report.
cues: Say that you will send it to her
Say that you will do it as soon as you finish it
b2-07-01.target: Te lo mando en cuanto lo termine.
b2-07-01.english: I'll send it to you as soon as I finish it.
b2-07-01.canDo: I can say what I will do as soon as something happens, using en cuanto, tan pronto como and apenas with the present subjunctive.

b2-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Waiting Until
b2-07-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are going to meet in Budapest, and he says he will be late. You tell him how long you will wait.
b2-07-02.prompt: Tell Carlos how long you will wait for him.
cues: Say that you will wait for him here
Say that you will wait until he arrives
b2-07-02.target: Te espero aquí hasta que llegues.
b2-07-02.english: I'll wait for you here until you arrive.
b2-07-02.canDo: I can say how long I will wait or when I will stop, using hasta que with the present subjunctive.

b2-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: As Long As
b2-07-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if she can use your computer. You agree, on one condition.
b2-07-03.prompt: Tell Meg she can use your computer, with your condition.
cues: Say that she can use your computer
Say that it is fine as long as she looks after it
b2-07-03.target: Puedes usar mi computadora mientras la cuides.
b2-07-03.english: You can use my computer as long as you look after it.
b2-07-03.canDo: I can use mientras with the subjunctive to say "as long as", for a duration or a condition.

b2-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Whenever It Rains
b2-07-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you do when it rains in Budapest. You stay at home every time it rains.
b2-07-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you do whenever it rains.
cues: Say that it happens every time it rains
Say that you stay at home
b2-07-04.target: Siempre que llueve, me quedo en casa.
b2-07-04.english: Whenever it rains, I stay at home.
b2-07-04.canDo: I can tell siempre que "whenever" with the indicative from siempre que "provided that" with the subjunctive.

b2-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Before You Go
b2-07-05.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg is about to go out, and you want her to phone you first.
b2-07-05.prompt: Ask Meg to phone you before she goes out.
cues: Say that she should do it before she leaves
b2-07-05.canDo: I can use antes de que with the subjunctive and después de que with the indicative for facts or the subjunctive for the future.

b2-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Working Until It Is Done
b2-07-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how long you will keep working at the office today. You will stay until you finish the report.
b2-07-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg how long you will keep working.
cues: Say that you will keep working
Say that you will stop when you finish the report
b2-07-consolidation.target: Voy a seguir trabajando hasta que termine el informe.
b2-07-consolidation.english: I'm going to keep working until I finish the report.
b2-07-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the future with en cuanto, tan pronto como, hasta que and mientras + the present subjunctive.
